qualifications: Central-coefficient parity is achieved; the author's fit values are reproduced at reported precision. Published central coefficients are reproduced on the recovered 22-row EoSFit export: 21 measured entries plus the derived Cernok (2014) fitted ambient anchor, not 22 independent measurements. All three BM3 coefficients vary, but the anchor's tiny sigma_P effectively pins V0 in the author-communicated pressure-only 1/sigma_P^2 objective; sigma_V is preserved but not propagated. Current-study V/Z is rounded to 0.1 A3 per formula unit. Original EoSFit settings, sigma_V treatment and covariance/uncertainty parity remain unverified. The older 24-row unweighted failure is a separate historical diagnostic, not the source fit-input reconstruction. Published coefficients are unchanged; this finding does not establish physical accuracy or recommendation.

fit.weighting: Sum[(P_BM3 - P_export)^2 / sigma_P_export^2]; sigma_V preserved but not used. Derived anchor sigma_P=0.0001 GPa effectively pins V0.
fit.covariance_convention: Reconstruction errors/covariance and original confidence convention are not established. No combined-two-sigma or uncertainty-parity claim; absolute_sigma describes the declared pressure weights only.
fit.comparison_scope: Central-coefficient parity is achieved; the author's fit values are reproduced at reported precision. The recovered 22 author-export inputs include a derived ambient anchor. Uncertainty/covariance parity and every original EoSFit configuration detail remain unverified.
